name: Acquiring Too Much
overview: Scripture warns against the pursuit of excessive material wealth, emphasizing that true security and treasure are found in heavenly, imperishable riches rather than earthly possessions. Jesus teaches that forsaking worldly goods and giving to the poor leads to eternal treasure and discipleship, as seen in His calls to sell all and follow Him (Matthew 19:21; Mark 10:21; Luke 12:33). Believers are reminded to prioritize God's kingdom and righteousness above all else, trusting that their needs will be provided for (Matthew 6:33). Additionally, Luke 12:48 highlights the responsibility that accompanies abundance, indicating that those entrusted with much will be held to greater accountability.
